SELECT sale_date, channel_code, channel_id, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dl, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) r, sum(net_amount) net, min(sale_ts_utc) mn, max(sale_ts_utc) mx, min(etl_loaded_at) l1, max(etl_loaded_at) l2

WITH w AS (SELECT f.*, o.status, o.fulfilment_type, o.login_state, o.order_total_gross, o.line_count
 FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-12-15' AND '2025-12-23' AND f.channel_id IN (2,3))
SELECT status, fulfilment_type, staff_purchase_flag, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) r, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) dl, sum(net_amount) net, sum(gross_amount) gr, sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, sum(CASE WHEN store_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nostore
FROM w GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT CAST(o.order_ts_utc + INTERVAL 2 HOUR AS DATE) d, o.status, count(*) orders, sum(o.order_total_gross) gross_tot, sum(o.line_count) lines,
 count(l.receipt_id) orders_with_lines
FROM fact_web_order o
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3)) l ON l.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
WHERE o.order_ts_utc BETWEEN '2025-12-14 20:00' AND '2025-12-24 00:00'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT r.return_date, f.channel_id, count(*) n, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, sum(f.net_amount) orig_net
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN '2025-12-15' AND '2025-12-23' AND f.channel_id IN (2,3)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT * FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id>=900 AND business_date BETWEEN '2025-12-14' AND '2025-12-24' ORDER BY 2,1
SELECT sale_date, sum(net_amount) net_before_returns, count(*) lines FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) AND sale_date BETWEEN '2025-12-15' AND '2025-12-23' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.store_id, f.channel_id orig_channel, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) dr, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, min(r.return_date) d1, max(r.return_date) d2
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN '2025-12-15' AND '2025-12-23' AND (f.channel_id IN (2,3) OR s.store_id>=900)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT return_line_id) d, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ds, (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id)) orphan FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN '2025-12-15' AND '2025-12-23'

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT sale_date AS business_date, sum(net_amount) AS net_before_returns
  FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' GROUP BY 1),
rets AS (
  SELECT r.return_date AS business_date, sum(r.refund_net) AS returns_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' GROUP BY 1),
alt AS (
  SELECT r.return_date AS business_date, sum(r.refund_net) AS alt_returns
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  WHERE f.channel_id IN (2,3) AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.business_date, s.net_before_returns, coalesce(r.returns_net,0) returns_net, s.net_before_returns - coalesce(r.returns_net,0) AS web_net_sales,
  s.net_before_returns - coalesce(a.alt_returns,0) AS alt_net
FROM sales s LEFT JOIN rets r USING (business_date) LEFT JOIN alt a USING (business_date) ORDER BY 1

SELECT CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE) utc_date, sum(net_amount) n, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) r, sum(CASE WHEN channel_id=2 THEN net_amount END) hd
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-14' AND DATE '2025-12-24' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
